name: Mosaic
description: An asymmetric, mixed-size layout of content blocks. Unlike a uniform Grid, items have intentionally varied sizes to create visual interest and hierarchy.

elements.name: Items
elements.description: Content blocks (images, cards, text) of varying sizes

usageNotes: Use for portfolios, image galleries, or content that benefits from visual variety. For uniform grids, use Grid. For image-only collections with captions, use Gallery (Figure collection).
Implement with CSS Grid using grid-template-columns and grid-column / grid-row spanning.
Plan the layout pattern in advance — random patterns can look chaotic if not carefully designed.
Ensure sufficient contrast for text overlays on images in mosaic cards.
On mobile, mosaic layouts typically revert to a single-column or simpler 2-column grid.
